# E-Learning Heroes Community

> The premier community platform for instructional designers, course creators, and eLearning professionals to share knowledge, showcase projects, and collaborate on Articulate products.

E-Learning Heroes is Articulate's official community hub where members discuss course design, share Rise 360 and Storyline 360 projects, participate in contests like Build-a-thon, and access early-access features through Articulate Labs. The community fosters peer learning and highlights innovative eLearning solutions built with Articulate's tools.

## Key Topics

- Rise 360
- Storyline 360
- Code Block
- Instructional Design
- Course Development
- Build-a-thon
- Accessibility
- E-Learning Tools
- Community Contest
- JavaScript
- Articulate Labs
- Template Creation Guild
- eLearning Development
- Course Design
- Articulate Products

## Community Hub & Getting Started

- [The eLearning Community for Instructional Designers](https://community.articulate.com): Homepage for #1 eLearning community for course creators and instructional designers
- [Welcome to Labs!](https://community.articulate.com/discussions/labs/welcome-to-labs/1248530): Introduction to Articulate Labs early-access feature testing program for community

## Build-a-thon & Creative Showcases

- [ELH Build-a-thon Winners: Creative Rise 360 Code Block Examples](https://community.articulate.com/discussions/exchange/congrats-to-our-build-a-thon-winners/1250351): Showcase of winning Rise 360 Code Block projects from Build-a-thon community contest
- [Meet Your Learner Persona](https://community.articulate.com/discussions/code-block-build-a-thon/meet-your-learner-persona/1249246): Build-a-thon submission: interactive learner persona tool using Rise Code Block
- [Accessibility Reality Checker (3 - minute Simulator)](https://community.articulate.com/discussions/code-block-build-a-thon/accessibility-reality-checker-3---minute-simulator/1249349): Build-a-thon submission: interactive accessibility simulator using Rise 360 Code Block
- [Paint by Num-Birds: Songbird Identification Tool](https://community.articulate.com/discussions/code-block-build-a-thon/paint-by-num-birds-songbird-identification-tool/1249484): Build-a-thon submission: interactive bird identification tool using Rise Code Block
